payload.title: Subscribe to publication and section RSS/Atom feeds
payload.description:
Design-only planning requested by Ryan during voice. Implementation remains unstarted; no code, infrastructure, deployment, purchase or publishing authorization is implied. Initial status stays open (Discovery), unassigned.

As a reader, I want RSS and Atom subscriptions at publication and section scope, so that my reader follows only the material I selected.

Acceptance behavior (planned, not executable or verified yet):
```gherkin
Feature: Subscribe to publication and section RSS/Atom feeds
  Scenario: Read publication and section subscriptions
    Given a publication with published articles in two sections and unpublished drafts
    When I request its publication RSS feed and Atom feed
    Then both describe its eligible published articles with titles, canonical links and publication timestamps
    When I request either format for one section
    Then only eligible articles in that section appear
    And an empty valid section produces a valid empty feed
    And drafts and other publications never appear
```
